title: Genuine Zero Uniform Atlas Energy
description: Lean 4 formalization of the native real-camera/Genuine zero identity, faithful empirical C2--C7 camera geometry, sharp cutoff-tail and collective raw-energy asymptotics, logarithmic cutoff jets, exact scaled-tail value/derivative bounds, and the concrete pointwise finite-to-infinite energy bridge. Version 0.12.0 adds an audited final-confinement frontier probe and a lateral canonical arithmetic-readout comparison while preserving the Genuine-first/native-first architecture. Carry geometry, quadratic amplitude, all-camera invariance, exact cutoff control, and real native operators remain foundational; the release does not promote readout-domain equivalences or numerical evidence to an unconditional confinement theorem.
